assert get_odd_occurence([5, 7, 2, 7, 5, 2, 5], 7) == 5

Write the t task named `get_odd_occurence` with 2 parameter(s) of type(s) seq, int, in the order the tests pass them, returning int. The tests must pass and the ensures must specify the result.
